title: The Kitchen before the hand-over
question: Round 7 was the last day anything new could be promoted, and the final AI draft goes to Caplet at the end of Wed 4 Nov. What did round 7 teach us about how we work, and what should round 8 do with a verify-only dial?
serves: Portfolio Analysis ('uses reasonable assumptions and projections to evaluate funding reliability'), the IPS instruction 'Clearly explain your team's investment strategy and the reasoning behind it', and 'a clear, cohesive, and well-supported investment strategy'; Commandment V; north star 4 (knowledge that is true, not just impressive)
essence: We first all agreed that tomorrow should protect the IPS from your rewrite, then all three of us changed our minds: Wednesday is our last day to check the draft, and the rewrite is yours from Thursday.

Checking tonight, we found our own 'wipe out the shares' test still treated the five bond funds as plain bonds; with the funds put back the way they really pay out, wiping every share still leaves every cheque whole.

Tomorrow three of us check the one new line nobody has sourced and re-check the checkers, and we write you a short list of the false versions each fact once had, so you can reword freely without landing on one.
decided: 3-0: round 8 checks C06 at its sources (lens 1, Invert); the rewrite is Caplet's from Thursday

3-0: Felix near sources 'which expires worthless unless the market rises' (P5); Tess far reads the Window's 08:40 answers back at their sources; 2-1: Nora re-runs Amara's test as the member who didn't build it
2-1: F24 goes to Caplet as a split, Final Report first, no IPS words from Keel (Amara: Nora checks first)
2-1: Kai builds (cuts the false-versions card), Jun hunts flaws, Amara judges cold (Felix: Jun judges, Amara cuts)
3-0: the card lists each false version beside its fact, no numbers, for the rewrite thread's final folder, never the IPS
3-0: LS-16, 'Before a model's clean number leaves its room, someone who didn't build it puts back the biggest thing it leaves out and runs it again; a list isn't a check.' (2-1 on the last clause)
seeds: 'Later bond payments' pulls the funds' own bonds inside the lock; 'later coupons' would shrink it below the sizing that already misses. Would Caplet ever know that word was holding a cheque up? (the card, Wed 13:40)

The updated IPS instructions' lines 79-80 ('Your portfolio and Final Report should reflect the strategy established in your IPS') are not in WHARTON_WORD, so no order can quote them (Library, after the freeze)
